text: Branch final-v3-experiments created from final-v3 (81813de); decoder-improvement-v1-experiments merged with a real merge commit (236ab49). Only README.md conflicted; rl/ and configs/rl_feedback.json byte-identical to rl-v2-experiments.

Workspace: the earlier project filer directories were purged on 2026-11-13, so a new filer workspace /data/rtxw01/nbak/robot_intel/kztrgg/projs/code/csci642-v3 was created (git init + fetch of this repository; no clone, no disconnected history). RL env venv/rl rebuilt with conda python=3.12.3 + pip install -r rl/requirements-lock.cluster.txt (same lock as v2); OSMesa prefix gl/ = conda-forge mesalib 24.3. v2 validation suites (w=0.1, 0.5) and the v2 final suite are restored from their Releases with hash checks (scripts/final_v3_restore_suite.py).

Stage 1 (sensitivity) runs from a commit whose RL training sources (rl/train.py, environment.py, feedback.py, checkpoint.py) are byte-identical to the v2 final commit 25bb0f4, so sparse/dense must reproduce the v2 final runs exactly. The protocol-v3 and preference code is committed only afterwards.

Sensitivity protocols w=0.1 and w=0.5 frozen with rl.freeze from their existing complete v2 validation suites (restored from rl-v2-validation-w010/-w050 Releases; every archive and file hash checked; not rerun). Rationale string exactly as in the handoff. Evidence runs equal reports/rl_v2_validation/candidate_*/runs.csv. Status: post-hoc sensitivity analysis requested after the v2 final results; the v2 primary result (w=1.0) is unchanged; not a re-selection.

Decoder test suite: tests.test_dimp + tests.test_closeout run in a new Python 3.11 env from requirements-lock.txt with the documented NCCL reinstall (reports/decoder_improvement/REPRODUCE.md) -> 31 tests OK; tests.test_feedback_vnext runs in the RL env as documented -> 35 tests OK (with rl.test_stage2), 1 skipped. Finding (pre-existing, not changed): scripts/download_feedback.py --profile rl_feedback_vnext.json reports 'Unexpected CSV schema' because the vnext tables carry 3 extra columns (recipe_id, p_error_temperature, margin); all vnext asset sizes/SHA-256 matched and FeedbackLibrary loads them (the vnext profile is unused for RL).

v3 selection rule declared in FINAL_V3_HANDOFF.md 6.3 and implemented as scripts/rl_select_candidate.py --metric auc (committed a09817f before any v3 validation run). v3 smoke passed (all seven conditions, reload, continuation) at a09817f. v3 validation suites v3_w050/w100/w200 (33 runs each, s11/s13, seeds 100-102) launched from a09817f.

Preference geometry check passed at a09817f on 100 evaluation + 3 trajectory goals (straight-line scripted controller violates on all 103 goals, pillar entry 103/103; left-detour reaches every goal without violation; 2060 labeled segments match the label definitions). Preference smoke passed. Pilots launched: sparse, dense, ideal, eegnet s11, cbramod s13 x seeds 900/901, w=1.0, 150k steps, geometry R=0.025 m, corridor a in [0.25, 0.75].

Operational: a submission call timed out after submitting the v3_validation_w200 jobs; a resubmission queued every w200 run a second time. The 33 later duplicates were killed while pending (none started); one job per planned run remains.
